entries.name: CustomerConflict
entries.signature: export declare const CustomerConflict: import("@arki/failure").FailureDefinition<"payments.customer_conflict", import("@standard-schema/spec").StandardSchemaV1<{ userId: string; providerCustomerId: string; existingCustomerId: string | null; }, { userId: string; providerCustomerId: string; existingCustomerId: string | null; }>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: A new customer clashes with a stored one: the user already has a customer with another provider id (`existingCustomerId` is that customer), or the provider id belongs to another user's customer (`existingCustomerId` is null). Nothing was written.

entries.signature: export declare const EffectiveDateOutsidePeriod: import("@arki/failure").FailureDefinition<"payments.effective_date_outside_period", import("@standard-schema/spec").StandardSchemaV1<{ subscriptionId: string; effectiveDate: string; periodStart: string; periodEnd: string; }, { subscriptionId: string; effectiveDate: string; periodStart: string; periodEnd: string; }>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: A plan change was asked to take effect outside the subscription's current period. Times are ISO instants.

entries.name: misconfigured
entries.signature: export declare function misconfigured(setting: string, problem: string): UnexpectedFailure<import("@arki/failure").Failure<"payments.configuration_invalid", { setting: string; problem: string; }>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: The thrown form of `payments.configuration_invalid`, for a setting the app passed when it built a service. Boot checks throw this; nothing at runtime does.

entries.name: NotificationFailed
entries.signature: export declare const NotificationFailed: import("@arki/failure").FailureDefinition<"payments.notification_failed", import("@standard-schema/spec").StandardSchemaV1<{ channel: "email" | "slack"; notification: "refund_approval_request" | "refund_failure_alert" | "refund_status_update"; status?: number | undefined; }, { channel: "email" | "slack"; notification: "refund_approval_request" | "refund_failure_alert" | "refund_status_update"; status?: number | undefined; }>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: A notification was not delivered: the mail transport returned a failure (the `cause`), the Slack webhook answered with a non-2xx `status`, or the request failed or timed out (the `cause`).

entries.name: PaymentsConfigurationInvalid
entries.signature: export declare const PaymentsConfigurationInvalid: import("@arki/failure").FailureDefinition<"payments.configuration_invalid", import("@standard-schema/spec").StandardSchemaV1<{ setting: string; problem: string; }, { setting: string; problem: string; }>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: The host app's setup of a payments service cannot work: a capability a configured step needs was not passed, or a setting is empty or malformed. Thrown when the service is built (at boot), never returned later as a silent no-op.

entries.name: PaymentWithoutSubscription
entries.signature: export declare const PaymentWithoutSubscription: import("@arki/failure").FailureDefinition<"payments.payment_without_subscription", import("@standard-schema/spec").StandardSchemaV1<{ paymentId: string; }, { paymentId: string; }>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: The payment belongs to no subscription, so there is no subscription to keep alive with retries. Nothing was scheduled.

entries.name: PlanCurrencyMismatch
entries.signature: export declare const PlanCurrencyMismatch: import("@arki/failure").FailureDefinition<"payments.plan_currency_mismatch", import("@standard-schema/spec").StandardSchemaV1<{ currentPlanId: string; newPlanId: string; currentCurrency: string; newCurrency: string; }, { currentPlanId: string; newPlanId: string; currentCurrency: string; newCurrency: string; }>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: The two plans of a plan change are priced in different currencies, so a credit on one cannot be set against a charge on the other.

entries.name: PlanInactive
entries.signature: export declare const PlanInactive: import("@arki/failure").FailureDefinition<"payments.plan_inactive", import("@standard-schema/spec").StandardSchemaV1<{ planId: string; }, { planId: string; }>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: The plan exists but is no longer offered (`isActive` is false). Nothing was sent to the provider or written.

entries.name: SubscriptionAlreadyActive
entries.signature: export declare const SubscriptionAlreadyActive: import("@arki/failure").FailureDefinition<"payments.subscription_already_active", import("@standard-schema/spec").StandardSchemaV1<{ userId: string; subscriptionId: string; }, { userId: string; subscriptionId: string; }>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: The user already has an active subscription, so a second one is not created. Nothing was sent to the provider or written.

entries.name: SubscriptionInvalidState
entries.signature: export declare const SubscriptionInvalidState: import("@arki/failure").FailureDefinition<"payments.subscription_invalid_state", import("@standard-schema/spec").StandardSchemaV1<{ subscriptionId: string; status: string; action: "cancel" | "pause" | "reactivate" | "resume" | "set_cancel_at_period_end" | "update"; }, { subscriptionId: string; status: string; action: "cancel" | "pause" | "reactivate" | "resume" | "set_cancel_at_period_end" | "update"; }>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: The subscription's status does not allow the change: an update or a pause needs `active`, a resume needs `paused`, a reactivation needs `canceled` or `past_due`, and a canceled subscription cannot be canceled or flagged again. Nothing was sent to the provider or written.

entries.signature: export type CoreWrites = { initiatePayment: (input: InitiatePaymentInput) => Promise<Payment | JournalWriteFailure>; completePayment: (input: CompletePaymentInput) => Promise<Payment | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; failPayment: (input: FailPaymentInput) => Promise<Payment | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; cancelPayment: (input: CancelPaymentInput) => Promise<Payment | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; /** The customer must act (for example 3-D Secure). An already waiting payment stays as it is. */ markPaymentRequiresAction: (input: MarkPaymentRequiresActionInput) => Promise<Payment | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; /** The provider refunded the payment. A total that is not higher writes nothing. */ recordPaymentRefund: (input: RecordPaymentRefundInput) => Promise<Payment | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound | CommandInvalid>; /** The same dispute and status again writes nothing. */ recordPaymentDispute: (input: RecordPaymentDisputeInput) => Promise<Payment | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; createSubscription: (input: CreateSubscriptionInput) => Promise<Subscription | JournalWriteFailure>; /** Create or update by provider subscription id. An unchanged delivery writes no event. */ syncSubscription: (input: SyncSubscriptionInput) => Promise<Subscription | JournalWriteFailure>; cancelSubscription: (input: CancelSubscriptionInput) => Promise<Subscription | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; reactivateSubscription: (input: ReactivateSubscriptionInput) => Promise<Subscription | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; pauseSubscription: (input: PauseSubscriptionInput) => Promise<Subscription | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; resumeSubscription: (input: ResumeSubscriptionInput) => Promise<Subscription | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; /** The same provider plan again writes nothing. */ changeSubscriptionPlan: (input: ChangeSubscriptionPlanInput) => Promise<Subscription | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; /** Set or clear ends at period end without changing the status. */ setSubscriptionCancelAtPeriodEnd: (input: SetSubscriptionCancelAtPeriodEndInput) => Promise<Subscription | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; markSubscriptionPastDue: (input: MarkSubscriptionPastDueInput) => Promise<Subscription | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; activateSubscription: (input: ActivateSubscriptionInput) => Promise<Subscription | JournalWriteFailure | CommandNotFound>; };

entries.name: TaxReportingService
entries.signature: export declare class TaxReportingService { private readonly reads; constructor(reads: TaxReportReads); /** * Generate the tax compliance report of a period, from what the package stored: the succeeded * payments, the tax records and the exemptions. Stripe Tax has no report endpoint, so nothing is * fetched from it. `reportType` names the report; the records do not tell VAT from sales tax. * `jurisdiction` (any case) limits the tax, and the payments to those it taxed. */ generateComplianceReport(params: { reportType: 'sales_and_use_tax' | 'vat' | 'gst'; period: ReportingPeriod; jurisdiction?: string; }): Promise<TaxComplianceReport>; /** * Get customer tax summary for a specific year (UTC): the customer's succeeded payments with the * tax recorded on each, and the exemptions in force during the year. */ getCustomerTaxSummary(customerId: CustomerId, year: number): Promise<CustomerTaxSummary | import("@arki/failure").Failure<"money.input_too_large", undefined> | import("@arki/failure").Failure<"money.invalid_shape", undefined> | import("@arki/failure").Failure<"money.invalid_text", undefined> | import("@arki/failure").Failure<"money.unknown_currency", undefined> | import("@arki/failure").Failure<"payments.stored_tax_invalid", { paymentId: string; problem: "not_money" | "other_currency"; paymentCurrency: string; taxCurrency: string | null; }>>; /** * Create audit trail entry for tax-related actions. The entry is stored; `id` and `timestamp` are the stored ones. */ createAuditEntry(entry: Omit<TaxAuditEntry, 'id' | 'timestamp'>): Promise<TaxAuditEntry>; /** The audit entries about one entity, oldest first. */ getAuditTrail(entity: TaxAuditEntry['entity'], entityId: string): Promise<TaxAuditEntry[]>; /** * The next filing deadline of each jurisdiction we are registered in. A jurisdiction is listed * when it requires registration, has a monthly, quarterly or annual `filingFrequency`, and the * default tax configuration holds an active registration for its country. The deadline is the * end (UTC) of the month after the filing period closes: the jurisdiction row stores no due day, * so this is the common rule, not a statute. Nearest first. */ getUpcomingDeadlines(asOf?: Instant): Promise<{ jurisdiction: string; type: string; deadline: Instant; description: string; priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'; }[]>; /** * Validate tax compliance status from what is stored: every active jurisdiction that requires * registration needs an active registration for its country in the default tax configuration * (none, or an inactive one, is critical; a pending one is a warning), and exemptions ending * within 30 days are a warning. */ validateComplianceStatus(): Promise<{ status: 'compliant' | 'warning' | 'non_compliant'; issues: { type: 'missing_registration' | 'expired_exemption' | 'overdue_filing' | 'missing_documentation'; jurisdiction: string; description: string; severity: 'critical' | 'warning' | 'info'; }[]; }>; /** * Export tax data for external systems: one row per succeeded payment of the period with the tax * recorded for it, and with `includeExemptions` one row per exemption in force in the period. * CSV values are quoted when they need it, and text that a spreadsheet would run as a formula is * prefixed with a quote. XML text is escaped, and characters XML 1.0 cannot hold are dropped. */ exportTaxData(params: { format: ExportTaxDataInput['format']; period: ReportingPeriod; includeExemptions?: boolean; }): Promise<{ format: string; data: string; filename: string; }>; /** * The succeeded payments of the period with their tax. Tax per payment is what the tax records * hold under its payment id (sales less refunds); a payment with none carried none. entries.name: jurisdictionOwnsLine
entries.signature: export declare function jurisdictionOwnsLine(jurisdiction: TaxJurisdiction, line: TaxBreakdownLine): boolean;
entries.jsdocSummary: True when Stripe's tax line is the tax of our jurisdiction. The display name alone cannot say: Georgia is a US state and a country. The line must be in the same country, at the same level, and in the same state. Stripe gives no code below the state, so a city, county or district must also carry the same name. A jurisdiction that cannot be placed this way matches nothing: tax is charged rather than wrongly waived.

entries.name: TaxService
entries.signature: export declare class TaxService { private readonly stripeProvider; private readonly reads; constructor(stripeProvider: StripeProvider, reads: TaxServiceReads); /** * Calculate tax for a potential purchase * This is used for price previews and checkout calculations * * Exemptions in force are applied. An active exemption keeps tax off a line when it is the * customer's own, or open to every customer but then tied to a product that is the line's tax * code or plan (a global exemption with no product would zero everyone's tax, so it never applies); one tied to a jurisdiction removes that jurisdiction's tax from the * breakdown, unless the tax is inclusive (it is part of the price then, and stays). A line that is * wholly exempt is not sent to Stripe. An exemption needs what its type says it is for (a customer, a product or a * jurisdiction): one without would exempt every sale, so it is never applied. * * A Stripe amount that `@arki/money` refuses (an unknown currency, units off Stripe's rule) is returned as a * `MoneyFailure`, so a sale is never priced with a wrong tax. */ calculateTax(input: TaxCalculationInput): Promise<Failure<"payments.tax_address_incomplete", undefined> | TaxCalculationResult | import("@arki/money").MoneyFailure>; /** * Create a tax transaction for compliance tracking * Called when a payment is successful or a refund is processed * * `breakdown` is the tax the checkout's `calculateTax` returned for this sale. It is stored, one * record per jurisdiction and rate, and is what `getCustomerTaxSummary` and the compliance report * add up. Recording a `reference` twice (for the same `type`) returns the first record and does * not call the provider again. A failure is the caller's to handle, as in `calculateTax`. */ createTaxTransaction(params: { reference: string; type: 'sale' | 'refund'; customerId?: CustomerId; paymentId?: PaymentId; subscriptionId?: SubscriptionId; /** Every line item is in `currency` */ lineItems: { amount: Money; description: string; reference: string; taxCode?: string; }[]; currency: string; customerDetails?: TaxCalculationInput['customerDetails']; /** The tax by jurisdiction, from `calculateTax`; every amount is in `currency` */ breakdown: TaxCalculationResult['breakdown']; /** When the sale or refund happened. Defaults to now. */ occurredAt?: Instant; /** For a `refund`: the `reference` of the recorded sale it reverses. Required there, ignored for a sale. */ originalReference?: string; }): Promise<Failure<"money.input_too_large", undefined> | Failure<"money.invalid_text", undefined> | Failure<"money.out_of_range", undefined> | Failure<"money.provider_amount", undefined> | Failure<"money.unknown_currency", undefined> | Failure<"payments.reference_not_found", { kind: "customer" | "payment" | "plan" | "subscription"; id: string; missing: "provider_id" | "row"; }> | Failure<"payments.tax_address_incomplete", undefined> | Failure<"payments.tax_currency_mismatch", { reference: string; jurisdiction: string; taxCurrency: string; transactionCurrency: string; }> | Failure<"payments.tax_refund_sale_not_found", { reference: string; originalReference: string | null; }> | TaxTransaction>; /** * Get tax settings and configuration * Useful for displaying tax information to customers */ getTaxSettings(): Promise<{ defaultTaxCode: string; headOfficeLocation?: { address: { country: string; state?: string; city?: string; line1?: string; postalCode?: string; }; }; taxRegistrations: { country: string; type: string; status: string; }[]; }>; /** * Calculate tax for subscription plans * Special handling for recurring billing scenarios */ calculateSubscriptionTax(params: { customerId: CustomerId; planAmount: Money; planInterval: 'monthly' | 'yearly' | 'weekly' | 'daily'; taxCode?: string; customerDetails?: TaxCalculationInput['customerDetails']; }): Promise<Failure<"payments.tax_address_incomplete", undefined> | TaxCalculationResult | import("@arki/money").MoneyFailure>; /** * Calculate tax for one-time payments (tips, donations) * Special handling for non-recurring transactions */ calculateOneTimeTax(params: { customerId: CustomerId; amount: Money; description: string; taxCode?: string; customerDetails?: TaxCalculationInput['customerDetails']; }): Promise<Failure<"payments.tax_address_incomplete", undefined> | TaxCalculationResult | import("@arki/money").MoneyFailure>; /** * Check the format of a customer's tax ID. The format only: whether the number is registered * takes the registry (VIES, HMRC, the IRS). `format: 'unknown'` means no format is known for * the type (or for the country under `eu_vat`); the ID is then not `valid`. */ validateTaxId(taxId: { type: string; value: string; country: string; }): Promise<{ valid: boolean; format: 'valid' | 'invalid' | 'unknown'; country?: string; type?: string; }>; /** * Get tax summary for a customer * Useful for customer portals and tax reporting * * Built from the tax records of the calendar year (UTC): what each jurisdiction collected on the * customer's sales, less what it gave back on refunds. Totals are one `Money` per currency * (never added across currencies), ordered by currency code; `breakdown` has one row per * jurisdiction and currency. `totalTransactions` counts the sales that carried tax. */ getCustomerTaxSummary(params: { customerId: CustomerId; year: number; }): Promise<{ totalTaxPaid: Money[]; totalTransactions: number; breakdown: { jurisdiction: string; taxAmount: Money; transactionCount: number; }[]; }>; }
